messages:
Alex M: FYI — partner (EdgeWave) wants to accelerate a 2-week co-sell POC. They need a joint arch that keeps customer data in their VPC, SSO via SAML, and a tight latency target. Can ops/eng confirm blockers?
Maya S: Thanks Alex. Sales note: EdgeWave will bring 5 internal apps hitting embeddings + chat. Their preliminary spend estimate is ~8M tokens / mo. Pricing question: can we do a blended rate for dedicated capacity for the POC?
Ravi K: For the VPC requirement we usually offer Private with a customer-managed peering/VPN. Two quick options: 1) Private deployment inside their VPC (customer runs runtime) or 2) Shared Dedicated with VPC egress + private control plane. Latency-wise, option 2 gives lower ops burden for the partner but needs egress rules.
Sara P: If they want the least ops for EdgeWave during a 2-week POC, we can provision a sandbox Dedicated pool scoped to the partner account and enable KV prefix caching for the embedding-heavy flows. We can also pre-enable quantization profiles to cut token cost.
John L: Security/Compliance check: we need answers to their security questionnaire around key management and audit logs. Specifically: do they require HSM-backed keys, and do we need to expose audit logs to their SIEM? Please share the questionnaire PDF.
Maya S: attaching their questionnaire (EdgeWave_SecQ_v1.pdf) — main asks: HSM support, data residency in eu-west, SOC2 plus customer audit window. They also asked about penetration test cadence.
Ravi K: On the network side — here's a small config sketch for egress routes we discussed:
```
# partner egress via NAT gateway
resource "aws_route_table" "peer_rt" {
  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.partner_nat.id
  }
}
```
We'll need their CIDR ranges and a stable public endpoint. Also recommend prefix routing for KV cache to reduce repeated tokenization overhead.
Alex M: Pricing/commit question — can we offer a temporary committed rate for the POC (2 weeks) or a usage credit? EdgeWave expects a quote by EOD Fri.
Sara P: We can provide a POC credit + an internal temporary blended per-token rate for the sandbox. Ops: will need an approval from finance for credit.
John L: I'll review the sec questionnaire today and flag any non-starters. If they insist on HSM we can integrate with their KMS or propose using our KMS with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key). Need legal for audit window.
OnboardBot: Sandbox tenant created: rw-partner-edgewave-sandbox (expires in 14 days). API keys provisioned for test team.
Maya S: Amazing — i'll loop in the partner PM and send the quote template. Who can own the tech call tomorrow 09:30 PST?
Ravi K: I can do the 09:30 slot and walk their infra engineer through VPC peering + egress flow. I'll bring a short runbook and the minimal terraform snippet.
Alex M: Action items: Maya to send questionnaire + quote request; John to validate security items; Sara to coordinate POC credit approval; Ravi to run tech call and share runbook. Please update this thread after each step. :thumbsup:
Maya S: Will do. Tagging @EdgeWave PM in email thread after call.
John L: Reviewed questionnaire — only two escalation points: HSM (optional) and customer audit window (need legal). I'll add comments inline and post a short summary here by 1700 PST.
Ravi K: Runbook link (draft): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edgewave-poc (notes: enable kv-cache, set quantization q4f16, set batch_size=8).
Sara P: Finance approved a $5k POC credit (covers 2 weeks at expected volume). I'll set the entitlements this afternoon.
Alex M: Great progress — bring-up call tomorrow then we can finalize quote. Thanks team.
